description: Returns one statutory EU compliance deadline by its exact id, with the Official Journal source, quote, SHA-256 and dated history of changes. Use it when you already have an id from compliance_list_deadlines; use compliance_list_deadlines to search by law or dates or to get several at once. Input: id (required, 1 to 80 lowercase letters/digits/hyphens, case-sensitive, e.g. eudr-large-medium-operators). Output: as_of, verified and deadline with obligation, date, previous_date, status, days_until, source URL, quote, SHA-256 and history. An unknown id returns the error deadline_not_found. Data is bundled from the acts and reviewed as of verified; days_until is computed today. Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors and empty answers are free. An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.

id.description: Exact case-sensitive id from compliance_list_deadlines, 1 to 80 lowercase ASCII letters/digits/hyphens, e.g. eudr-large-medium-operators

name: compliance_get_deadline
title: Get one EU compliance deadline
